# Isaiah Chapter 46 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 13 verses]*

*Bel and Nebo fall; idols carried by beasts; God carries Israel; no one like God*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 46 (Gods of Babylon) addresses bel and nebo fall; idols carried by beasts; god carries israel; no one like god. The key verse — "I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Second Isaiah (chs. 40-55), focused on comfort, restoration, and the servant figure.
